title: Peregrine Corporation - proposed acquisition of retail assets of Mobil Oil Australia Pty Ltd

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
Former proposed date for announcement of ACCC's findings of 8 July 2010 amended to allow ACCC to consider further information provided by Peregrine and to conduct further analysis.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition, subject to the receipt of divestiture undertakings from Peregrine.

ACCC confirmed that the s87B Undertaking had terminated on the basis that the sale of the divestiture businesses had completed and any obligations to procure the transfer, grant, or provision of licences, permits, approvals, third party consents and transitional services necessary for the operation of the divestiture businesses had been fulfilled.

body_sections.Undertakings:
Final 87B Undertakings - 

On 16 February 2011 the ACCC confirmed that the s87B Undertaking had terminated on the basis that the sale of the divestiture businesses has completed and any obligations to procure the transfer, grant, or provision of licences, permits, approvals, third party consents and transitional services necessary for the operation of the divestiture businesses has been fulfilled.
